claude.rationale: The slice documents impairment charges and a net-income decline explicitly attributed to a 2020 commodity demand-and-supply disruption associated with the COVID-19 pandemic and a share-price/market-cap decline — an external market shock, not a product/process integration failure (p4=0). It records organizational continuity (Terry K. Spencer continuing as President and CEO; the Partnership continuing as a wholly owned consolidated subsidiary) with no documented operations-vs-people/culture fracture (p5=0). No documented incoherence in controlling intent or business-model incompatibility appears; the combined business remained investment-grade rated and raised its dividend.
